title: MI60031: Advanced Subsurface Coal Mining
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Face mechanization in bord and pillar and longwall mining. Top coal caving,
Layout of faces, face equipment; conveying and supporting systems their
selection and organization. Thick seam and steeply inclined mining methods.
Wongawilli system, Room and Pillar extraction system, Hydraulic mining of coal
seams. ,underground coal gasification.
